what: For each confirmed consequential error in the random sample: where in the saved judgment (latest sel/sel2 run) the judge names the error the reviewer found. Reads the whole judgment, not only the failed requirements: 'requirement' = a failed requirement names it (scored, with a severity); 'verdict' = named only in the judge's overall task verdict (task_fulfillment), which carries no severity and no requirement id; 'related' = a failed requirement names the same mechanism on a different item; 'missed' = not named anywhere in the judgment. Site copy, not a label: labels and judgments are unchanged. Replaces the requirement-only reading in judge_match_v31.json as the page's located count.
written_by: Claude (assistant), from the saved judgments and the verified reviewer notes, at the author's request, after an external review found that the requirement-only count missed errors named in the task verdict

values.requirement: a failed requirement names the reviewer's error
values.verdict: named only in the overall task verdict: no requirement, no severity
values.related: a failed requirement names the same kind of error on a different item
values.missed: not named anywhere in the judgment
